normal_export_defect.cause: 导出节点改变顶点坐标后使 trimesh 法线缓存失效，又将已经重新计算的法线再旋转一次。
normal_export_defect.repair: 保留原件，在副本上对识别出的错误法线绕 X 轴旋转 +90°；数值验证后才保存。
normal_export_defect.scope: 修正表面明暗，不修正原有几何、闭眼、布料破洞、草叶熔化或配色。
normal_export_defect.new_inspections: inspect_model.py 自动检测与修正导出副本；未修改共享 ComfyUI 安装。

mesh_preservation_trial.finding: Installed nodes_unwrap.py ProcessMesh remesh-on hardcodes resolution=512 after 1024 generation.
mesh_preservation_trial.trial: Same reference, seed, 1024 cascade and official sampler; disable remesh, disable fill-holes and retain 3M faces.
mesh_preservation_trial.conclusion: Author verified sharper bark and lichen. Independent review still fails: foliage colour and fused shape, floating fragments, torso texture distortion and fused roots. Raw clay retains more detail but contains voxel noise and fragments. No acceptance implied.
mesh_preservation_trial.new_batch_requests: Scheduler resumed with preserve mesh profile; m15 existing baseline receipt retained. Prior models unchanged.

ground_fragment_diagnosis.method: Weld coincident UV-split vertices in analysis; remove disconnected components wholly below a principal body with >95% area and each below-body component <0.5% area. Re-ground from remaining geometry.
ground_fragment_diagnosis.new_imports: inspect_model.py applies this to NPC exports except Wisp; raw GLB retained.
ground_fragment_diagnosis.rejected_trial: m5 r02 analysed UV-split vertices as physical components; rejected and superseded by seam-aware r03.
